prompts.dark:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for a richly handcrafted PAPER POPUP battle terrarium. Genuine transparent background. Square 1536x1536 image, EXACT 3 by 3 equal grid of nine isolated objects, one object per cell, transparent gaps at least 30 pixels on all sides. No grid lines, no labels. Every object thin flat hand-cut colored cardstock, visible fibers and overlapping cut edges, soft shallow contact shadows, front orthographic view except floor is orthographic TOP DOWN. NO thick polygonal 3D sculptures, no bevel-rendered architecture, no finished room backdrop. Match a tactile Paper Mario theatrical craft style. No characters, no Pokeball shell. Contents by row:
ROW 1 LEFT: simple unadorned tall arched backing sheet, a solid colored sheet with very faint tone-on-tone motif only. NO room furniture drawn on backing.
ROW 1 MIDDLE: HOLLOW open doorway/roof arch made from thin overlapping paper ribs, completely transparent through its center.
ROW 1 RIGHT: standalone tall asymmetric pillar cluster.
ROW 2 LEFT: separate wide low balustrade/altar silhouette.
ROW 2 MIDDLE: hanging wide horizontal paper garland or mobile with 3 elements and strings, isolated.
ROW 2 RIGHT: one central medallion/relief or thematic mechanism, isolated.
ROW 3 LEFT: perfectly square FULLY FILLED top-down floor tile with fine surface texture, unobstructed center battle circle, absolutely no perspective, no border transparency inside this square.
ROW 3 MIDDLE: small wide low trainer podium, front view, slight visible horizontal top, broad clear flat top and grounded paper base.
ROW 3 RIGHT: a low decorative foreground cluster, irregular paper silhouette.
Crucial: ALL NINE objects independent with visible transparent margins, NO big composite scene. Distinct layered cut paper silhouettes, high craftsmanship, precise clean edges and no cropped objects. Theme: Sidney's DARK elite battle room in Pokémon Emerald. Warm ochre stone, dark olive/slate, burgundy paper drapes, understated gold details. Plain charcoal backing has faint angular diamonds; open layered ochre temple arch; three asymmetric ochre square columns with dark capstones; low burgundy and ochre ceremonial rail with alternating diamonds; three torn pointed burgundy pennants hanging from gold string; central dark crescent ring layered in dark olive and gold (no words); square ochre stone floor with deep burgundy straight central carpet and an understated cream battle circle; ochre stone trainer plinth; foreground jagged dark leaves beside folded stone fragments. Regal somber chamber, no halloween pumpkins or graves.
